conditions.label: Valuation
conditions.short: Trailing P/E against the universe, in thirds.
conditions.detail: The stock's trailing P/E (Screener.in, refreshed weekly) is ranked against every other scanned name. The cheapest third reads Undervalued, the middle third Reasonably valued, the richest third Overvalued. Names with no P/E — losses, blank filings — read N/A and cannot pass.

conditions.label: Earnings Power
conditions.short: Profit growth and returns on equity, together.
conditions.detail: Strong requires trailing-twelve-month profit growth of at least the calibrated floor AND return on equity at or above the calibrated floor. Both come from the weekly fundamentals cache. Either falling short reads Weak.

conditions.label: Momentum
conditions.short: Blended 3- and 6-month excess return vs the index.
conditions.detail: The average of the stock's 63-session and 126-session returns minus the Nifty 50's over the same windows. Ranked across the universe: the top decile reads Very Strong momentum, roughly the next sixth reads Strong momentum, everything else Weak momentum.

conditions.label: Price Contraction
conditions.short: ATR% below its own six-month norm.
conditions.detail: The 14-session ATR as a percentage of price, divided by its own median over the last 120 sessions. At or below parity the day ranges are shrinking relative to their recent norm — supply and demand are agreeing on smaller increments.

conditions.label: Timeframe Alignment
conditions.short: Daily and weekly averages stacked upward.
conditions.detail: On the daily tape the close sits above the 20- and 50-day averages with the 20 above the 50 and the 50 above the 150; on the weekly tape the close sits above a rising 30-week average. Both timeframes agree, or the condition fails.

conditions.label: Outperformance
conditions.short: Twelve-month return ahead of the index.
conditions.detail: The 252-session return minus the Nifty 50's over the same span, cleared by a small calibrated margin so noise around zero does not pass. Positive means the name beat the index it competes with for capital.

conditions.label: Institutional Candles
conditions.short: High-volume bullish days in the last ten sessions.
conditions.detail: A candle qualifies when it closes up, closes in the top third of its range, and trades at least the calibrated multiple of its 50-day volume — the footprint of size leaning on the offer. The reading is the count over ten sessions; anything above zero passes.

conditions.label: Short-term Extension
conditions.detail: Fails when RSI(14) reaches the calibrated ceiling or the close stands more than two ATRs above the 20-day average — a pullback-prone stretch. It passes almost every name almost every night, which is the point: when it does fail, it matters.

conditions.label: Long-term Extension
conditions.detail: Fails when the close stands more than the calibrated percentage above its 50-day average. Vertical moves mean-revert before bases can form; the condition refuses to score them while they last.

conditions.label: Stage Analysis
conditions.detail: Price above a rising 30-week average with relative strength improving reads Stage 2 - Uptrend and passes. Price below a falling one reads Stage 4 - Downtrend. Everything in between — bases and tops — reads Not Confirmed and fails until it resolves.

conditions.label: Dow Theory (W)
conditions.short: Weekly swing structure: highs and lows agreeing.
conditions.detail: Fractal swing pivots on the weekly chart over the past six months. Higher highs with higher lows read Uptrend; lower highs with lower lows read Downtrend; anything mixed reads Sideways. Only Uptrend passes.
